nodes.label: General brief rules (Aturan umum brief) for the sub-sessions of the scope 010 coordination: the fixed part of every brief; the brief the lead sends points to this file, and the brief wins where the two differ
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Sub-session flow: read the brief, this file, then .claude/skills/coordinate/roles/<role>.md, call the skill the brief names via the Skill tool, then work in the existing worktree and branch; a reused session runs git merge main first; other branches, pushes and PRs are not the sub-session's job
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Project adjustments: the role files were written for another Rust project; this repo has no cargo xtask, stackly_testkit, clients/swift, evidence/, prd.md or test-preferences.json; scope is in docs/scope/_root/, specs in docs/specs/_root/<NNNN-slug>/; evidence is the commands and output in the report
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Standby first turn of a new session: when the brief says standby, only read the brief, this file and the role, then end the turn with STATUS: standby without sending a message; the lead sends the full brief and 'mulai' via SendMessage
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Graph before reading: run graphify query (budget 1500) and graphify explain against the main checkout's graphify-out/graph.json before reading files for code, contracts or decisions; open files only at the location shown; never change any file in the main checkout
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Lead address: the lead session Mobile Foundation Scaffold; full reports, questions and needs-decision go there via SendMessage; other sub-sessions are found in ListAgents by title prefix; sessions of this coordination always use f010, unlike similarly named sessions of other projects on this Mac
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Always forbidden: docs/scope/, AGENTS.md, graphify-out/, spec content other than the **Status** line and verify.md ticks (except the architect on its own spec), other specs, and files outside 'File yang BOLEH diubah'; changes outside ownership are requested from the owner or the lead
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Generated files rule: never hand-edit generator output; change the source (design-system/tokens/, design-system/schemas/, shared/localization/, shared/specifications/, tooling/codegen/), run scripts/generate-design-tokens.sh and the generators scripts/test.sh checks, commit output with its source
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Graph and commit rule: AGENTS.md asks for /graphify . --update before commit; in this coordination the lead fulfils it when merging to main; sub-sessions do not run graphify update or /graphify and stage nothing under graphify-out/
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Decision rule (mode auto): the architect still sends an 'Accept this spec?' summary to the lead and waits for accept; other roles read rationale.md for an ambiguous AC, take the reading closest to the AC text and record it in 'Tafsiran AC'; needs-decision only if AC text or a spec decision must change
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Manual steps rule: GUI apps such as Xcode, GitHub web pages, physical devices, signing, tool installs, repo settings, pushes and workflow triggers are run only by the user or lead and go in the report's 'Langkah manual' field; gh is read-only; headless simulators are allowed; a failed step is not manual
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Sample removal only on a copy: proof that the catalog and token set pass without the greeting names runs on test fixtures or a temporary scratchpad clone, never by leaving the worktree with the samples deleted; scripts/init-project.sh --name only in a temporary clone, --check and --test are safe
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Disk rule: 22 GiB free at the start; one full native build at a time (the developer for the platform it touches, then the checker); the tester builds only if the brief asks; run df -g . first; below 10 GiB free stop and report blocked; remove target/, build/ and scratchpad clones before done
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md
nodes.rationale: Sessions of other projects also build on the same Mac, so free disk is shared and full native builds must not overlap.

nodes.label: Process rule: stop only processes, simulators and emulators you started yourself, name them uniquely (F010-<session name>) and delete them afterwards; a suite longer than 10 minutes runs detached with nohup and a scratchpad log
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md
nodes.rationale: Background commands are cut off at 10 minutes.

nodes.label: Verification before reporting: scripts/test.sh must exit 0; if apps/ios/ changed run scripts/build-ios.sh simulator, device and test light and dark; if apps/android/ changed run scripts/build-android.sh assemble and connected tests in both night modes; git status clean, diff only ownership files
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Skill panel answers: every panel is answered from this list or sent to the lead: spec gap = own reading or needs-decision; spec cross check = Another model; Save to verify.md; commit directly on this branch; Yes, run and fix to green; Specific files; scope tracking, done offers and /clear are skipped
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md
nodes.rationale: AskUserQuestion does not wake the lead, so a panel left open would stall the sub-session.

nodes.label: Commit rule: one commit per step, an English imperative subject without a prefix like this repo's history (e.g. 'Plan and specify a new project from the foundation'), plus the Co-Authored-By trailer from the session's system reminder; the developer moves the spec **Status** from Proposed to In Progress
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Report rule: one final report per item with no interim messages to the lead, following templates/report.md via SendMessage; done is valid only when all is committed, the tree is clean and the last git merge main ran; then wrap_up with a first line STATUS: ...; the lead reads only the first 400 characters
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md
nodes.rationale: The app holds back messages to the lead after about 20 messages, so interim messages would block the final report.

nodes.label: Session model per role: architect claude-fable-5-2 high; developer claude-opus-5-5 medium; tester claude-opus-5-5 high; checker verify claude-fable-5-2 high; debugger claude-fable-5-2 medium; report the model and effort from get_session "self"
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Additional user conditions (Ketentuan tambahan user) for the scope 010 coordination: none
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/010 - Schemas free of sample names.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Scope 010 specifics: main at start = 7b6ca4f, equal to origin/main; one feature with one open box, Design it (spec); spec number 0004; source is the spec 0003 Follow-up on greeting_recipient and the greeting role; Beta flow closes with Verify it and Test it; one developer until the lead splits ownership
